entities.name: Hermann von Oppeln-Bronikowski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hermann Leopold August von Oppeln-Bronikowski was an Olympic equestrian, winning a gold medal in the team dressage at the 1936 Olympics. He later served as a panzer general during World War II.
